documents.unit: AI at Amherst (Academic Technology Services / IT)
documents.title: Updated AI Usage Guidelines
documents.quality_note: Short but substantive: responsible use, privacy/data classification, verification, transparency. Aimed mostly at employees; little on student coursework. First fetch hit a 504; second succeeded.

notes: The December 2023 Task Force report PDF is password-protected (inaccessible). Searches indicate the Honor Code covers 'inappropriate use of generative AI' and course policies are set by instructors, but the Honor Code page itself was not fetched. No CS department policy found.
